note: Two of the five criteria cannot be assessed from this transcript at all, which is itself the finding: the rep never asked what the prospect does for a living, despite the prospect twice naming a job change as the cause of his decline, so 'successful' is unassessed and excluded from both lists. On what is observable he sits at the edge. Clearly not the excluded profile — a three-year competitive rower who still runs every other day and rejoined a gym unprompted the week before. Health is genuinely the neglected area of a busy London professional life. But he is restoring rather than going good to great: 'I want to build myself back up', 'do as many push-ups as I was able to before'. Income reads as a miss on the only evidence available — offered a straight choice between £4,400 and £150 a month he took the cheaper option instantly and without discussion.
